detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation via Hybrid Architectures and Goal Generation
detail.summary: Autonomous systems require self-generated goals and open-ended learning mechanisms to acquire flexible skills in unpredictable environments. Analysis of resource constraints suggests meta-strategies for exploration, while urban mobility models reveal the failure modes of unmanaged systems in non-stationary settings.
detail.reason: Synthesizing new evidence into the notebook allows for a more robust understanding of how agent limitations and environment non-stationarity influence autonomous inquiry.

detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Investigation
detail.question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?
detail.reason: Continuing active work under the unassigned problem topic with freshly collected source evidence.
